name: Shepherds
overview: Scripture reveals the role of shepherds as caretakers who lead and protect their flocks with tenderness and vigilance, as seen in Genesis where Abel is identified as a keeper of sheep and Jacob’s family carefully tends their flocks to prevent harm. Shepherds are portrayed as leaders who go before their sheep, ensuring their safety and seeking good pasture, exemplified by the careful guidance described in Genesis 33. The cultural context also reflects the low regard for shepherds among the Egyptians, highlighting the distinctiveness of their calling. Additionally, the practice of passing animals under the rod for tithing in Leviticus underscores the shepherd’s responsibility in managing and accounting for their flock.
